title: CustomersCustomerBlockedPayload
description: Payload of `customers.customer.blocked` version 1: support blocked a customer's account with a reason. Every session ended at once; refreshes, sign-in and placing orders are refused; orders already placed run to their end. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`. The payload carries no phone number or email. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

customer_id.description: The customer (a user id); fetch personal data from the API when it is needed.
